title: Seventeen to Twenty
label: ch:mr-seventeen-to-twenty
canDo: I can count to twenty, and I can build nineteen the way Marathi does -- one less than twenty rather than nine and ten.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R58-seventeen-to-twenty and count one to twenty, then take ekoNiis apart into ek plus uun plus viis.
payoff.note: ekoNiis counts DOWN from twenty, which is a different idea from every number before it and the one that buys every other nineteen in the language.
